title: Lead 75
subtitle: The 75 highest-value questions for senior and lead front end interviews.
description: A curated core list that covers every round of a senior or lead loop: JavaScript utilities and async control, accessible React components, the algorithms that show up in front end loops, the quiz topics interviewers probe hardest, system design (application, component and platform level), and the leadership stories every lead candidate needs. Start here if you only do one plan.

sections.description: Utilities and async primitives asked most often.

sections.description: The DSA patterns front end loops actually use.

title: 1 Week Plan
subtitle: Interview in a week? The essentials, day by day.
description: A compressed plan for when the interview is close. Each day mixes one theme of coding with the concepts behind it, and the last two days go to system design and stories. Skim the playbooks first, then do these in order.
audience: Anyone with an interview in ~7 days

title: 1 Month Plan
subtitle: A balanced four-week plan covering every round.
description: Four themed weeks: JavaScript and async, React and UI coding, algorithms and the web platform, then system design and leadership. Each week mixes practice with the quiz concepts behind it so you can explain your code as well as write it.

title: 3 Months Plan
subtitle: Everything in the question bank, in a sensible order.
description: The complete bank (658 questions) in twelve weekly blocks. Coding first, since it takes the longest to build fluency, then concepts, then system design and leadership. Mark what you already know as complete to keep it moving.
audience: Thorough preparation / career switch into senior roles

sections.title: Week 10: Web platform, CSS, HTML, performance & security

title: Senior & Lead Track (8 weeks)
subtitle: For the parts of a lead loop that coding practice does not cover.
description: Lead and staff loops weigh architecture, system design depth, and leadership as heavily as coding. This track goes through every system design question (application, component and platform), the performance/security/architecture concepts leads are expected to own, and the full behavioral bank. Pair it with the Senior & Lead Track guide.
